label: ENGINEERING_ONLY — NOT REAL LLM EVIDENCE
project_thesis: Final task success can hide which agentic skills survive under controlled interventions; CausalAgentBench pairs clean and intervention instances to measure robustness beyond final-answer scoring.
what_this_demo_proves: End-to-end pipeline: config → run → score → analyze → export → report → failure gallery
Mock diagnostic agent executes scripted failure modes deterministically
Scoring and trajectory diagnostics fire on mock trajectories
Paper asset export labels engineering_only and blocks paper claims
Evidence safety gates remain satisfied after a micro run
what_this_demo_does_not_prove: Real LLM agent behavior or performance
Model rankings or clean-vs-intervention degradation at scale
limitations: n=3 trajectories on travel_planning subset only
Single mock agent with scripted tool_overuser behavior
Exported figures are diagnostic illustrations, not submission figures
next_real_experiment: Bounded provider pilot (configs/pilot_multi_provider_20.yaml) after budget approval and PRE_EXPERIMENT_FREEZE_CHECKLIST
claim_ledger_impact: No changes — C1–C8/C10 remain planned; C9 engineering_only only
